name: Warm Up Carolina Pride 2026

venue.name: North Carolina State University Talley Student Union
venue.details: State Ballroom on the 3rd floor (one floor up from main level entrances)

information:
North Carolina and Southeast Cubing, Inc. would like to welcome everyone to Raleigh for **[Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026)**! This Pride competition is to celebrate and support LGBTQ+ cubers and allies. Any person may register for this competition.

**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpCarolinaPride2026#71720-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

$5 from every registration will be donated to **[The Trevor Project](https://www.thetrevorproject.org/)**. Their mission is to end suicide among LGBTQ+ young people and provide them support.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpCarolinaPride2026#71728-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
